description: Cheap stocks on trailing earnings over market value earn more than expensive ones, as investors over-extrapolate growth. Fundamentals are point-in-time: only figures filed on or before each rebalance are used. Falsified if it does not beat the equal-weight benchmark after 10 bps costs.
title: Value · earnings yield · top 50 of the Top 500 (after Basu 1977; Fama & French 1992) · long only
